config.architecture: birth attention flow; strict local Poisson elastic collision; Hc32; S4
config.proposal: numpy PCG64 Poisson; all-candidate CPU DAG v1
config.input_semantics: birth only; subsequent observed tokens enter force
config.gradient: window-truncated pathwise + causal Bernoulli score prefix

protocol: Frozen weights; common text/noise/proposals. Zero birth starts at history origin; other interventions start after common history. Fixed gamma matched to branchpoint spatial mean. No-drive removes full learned bounded drive, not harmonic trap. Not a Transformer training comparison.
limitations: 4 held-out text locations, 512 scored tokens; exploratory frozen-checkpoint interventions
No matched retraining or Transformer baseline; deltas are not additive contribution fractions
No-drive removes the text input channel; no-transport causes distribution shift
Birth-only state intervention is not removal of shared embedding weights
